pythonFunction.name: usps_v3_validate_address
pythonFunction.description:
Validates and standardizes a US street address against the stored address table. Returns the
standard form with a delivery confirmation code (Y, S, D or N) or an error code
ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND, MULTIPLE_ADDRESSES or INSUFFICIENT_ADDRESS. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    street: House number and street, with unit if any (REQUIRED).
    city: City.
    state: Two-letter state.
    zip: Five-digit ZIP code.

Returns:
    dict with ok, standardized_address, zip_plus4 and dpvConfirmation; on failure ok is false
    with error_code and agent_action.
